svg.title: Modified dispersion relation after scale separation
svg.desc: Integral from t min to Lambda of Im Pi of s over s minus q squared equals pi Pi of q squared minus the integral from Lambda to infinity of Im Pi of s over s minus q squared.

g.font-family: Times New Roman, STIX Two Text, serif
g.text: ∫Λtmin ds Im Π(s)/(s − q²) = π Π(q²)
